verdict.rationale: Synctera documents domestic wires over Fedwire as part of its API docs, so one of the three faster rails is evidenced. Nothing in the pack covers RTP or FedNow. The real-time Internal Transfer API only moves funds between two Synctera accounts, so it is a different capability and earns no credit for RTP or FedNow. Missing for 10: RTP origination/receipt, FedNow origination/receipt, explicit wire receipt vs origination documentation, per-rail capability comparison, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the faster rails are there when I need them — domestic wires, RTP, and FedNow origination and receipt through the same API, with per-rail capabilities documented

citations.quote: Domestic wires refer to the transfer of funds between 2 US based accounts.
Domestic wire transfers through the Fedwire system are processed in real-time, which means that transactions are settled immediately upon receipt.
